label: Freelance work
summary: Freelance work, for Maaike, refers to the practice of working independently as a consultant rather than within a salaried corporate structure. It is the context in which she founded Convocat, operating as a conversation designer and community builder. The concept encompasses not just the practical mechanics of self-employment but the broader shift in identity, motivation, and working style that comes with leaving corporate life.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike reflects on freelance work as something she was suited to long before she actually made the leap, pointing to her pattern of hopping between topics and her fierce independence as signs she was a freelancer at heart during her 20-year corporate career. She describes a deliberate exit strategy involving financial preparation and gradual psychological detachment from corporate identity, framing freelancing less as a job change and more as a realignment with her own energy and drives. She also connects her synesthetic, dot-connecting way of thinking directly to freelance work, arguing it is a better fit there than inside rigid organisational structures.
